The sequence is an **adenine phosphoribosyltransferase (APRT; EC 2.4.2.7)**. It is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein A8G657 from *Prochlorococcus marinus* MIT 9215.

**Reaction, in the AMP-forming direction:**

**Adenine + 5-phospho-α-D-ribose 1-diphosphate (PRPP) → AMP + diphosphate (pyrophosphate)**

APRT transfers the phosphoribosyl group from PRPP to adenine, producing AMP in the purine salvage pathway. The annotation maps this reaction to Rhea RHEA:16609. The evidence strongly supports this enzyme assignment; the sequence analysis itself does not provide experimental measurements of activity or kinetics.
